title: Marian S Probable NDE 5424
content: I was a teenager at the time of my experience. On 12/27/1987, I woke early with severe pain in my abdomen and went to see my doctor with my mother. He immediately referred me to the Hospital for emergency surgery. It was midday when my mother and I arrived. We waited in their hallway for three hours, along with several other people who were there for other reasons. I had a fever and my temperature was over 104°F. My mother gave the staff a hard time because of the lengthy wait and that increased my anxiety. The pain was unbearable and I was experiencing a reddish flicker in front of my eyes. After waiting some considerable time, I was finally called. They gave me anesthesia. Whilst under the anesthetic, I noticed that I could hear what the doctors and other staff were saying to each other in the operating theatre. Then I found myself floating just above my body. From that vantage point, I observed the doctors bustling around and looking worried. They were to the left of me, to the right and even beneath the gurney. Everything seemed to be bathed in a purple light giving the whole scene a mystical ambiance. A bright, white light was shining on the end of the gurney and the doctors were fading in and out of my vision. It was almost as if I were seeing them in a series of endless mirrors. They were moving away from me, receding into smaller and smaller shapes repeatedly. Their spoken words seemed to echo. It felt as if I were floating in an in-between world. That was it, until I woke up lying on a gurney.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Perceived operating theatre scene in 'purple light' with a bright white light at the end of the gurney; doctors appeared to recede repeatedly 'as if ... endless mirrors' and words echoed; described as 'floating in an in-between world.'
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE occurred during anesthesia with transitional, in-between visual effects; no tunnel/arrival realm/life review/boundary described; then awakening back on gurney.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Operating theatre perceived as bathed in purple light; doctors fading in and out and receding repeatedly 'as if ... endless mirrors'; echoing speech; described as an 'in-between world.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Everything seemed to be bathed in a purple light giving the whole scene a mystical ambiance.” “It was almost as if I were seeing them in a series of endless mirrors.” “It felt as if I were floating in an in-between world.”
